Jia (PM): Heads-up — large retail customer requested contract language tying model onboarding to reserved capacity SLAs. They want latency guarantees + a migration window for pin changes. Can we draft acceptance criteria?
Elaine (Product): Clarify whether every model must be dedicated or if it's tiered (dedicated vs hosted).
Jia (PM): They want two lanes: 1) Capacity-backed (Dedicated reserved pool, SLA 99.9% uptime + p95 < 250ms) and 2) Standard-hosted (best-effort). They expect a 90-day migration window pre-deprecation.
Sam (Eng): For capacity-backed we need a benchmark + regression gate. Define seq length, QPS profile, and KV-cache warmup expectations.
Omar (SRE): Also need templates mapping GPUs -> QPS. Avoid hard numbers without sizing; propose templates: small (1 A100 equiv), med (4), large (8+). Also call out burst capacity behavior.
Elaine (Product): Proposed acceptance: 1) perf: p95 <= 250ms at seq=128 under target QPS (use template), 2) stability: 99.9% uptime over 7-day canary, 3) quality: >=95% pass on onboarding eval set.
Sam (Eng): Add memory/kv metrics during canary (cold-start rate < X%, cache-hit >= Y%). Require model artifacts compatible with runtime (quantized/formats) for Dedicated lane.
Jia (PM): On deprecation: customer asks for 90-day notice + optional compatibility shim for 30 days post-deprecation. Can we offer a shim and estimate cost?
Omar (SRE): Shim doable but expensive (dual-serving + translation). Recommend it as a billable migration-assist add-on. Standard customers get 90-day notice + migration playbook.
Sam (Eng): If shim used, include rollback criteria and circuit breaker: start with 2% traffic to new model, expand if no regressions; provide per-prompt diffs in Console.
Elaine (Product): Tie in Redwood Optimize: suggest batching, quantization tier, and sequence caps to meet p95. Include example cost split for capacity-backed customers.
Jia (PM): Action items: Eng to propose benchmark harness + perf thresholds (Sam) — due EOD Tue. SRE to draft capacity templates + migration-assist cost (Omar) — due Thu. Product to draft contract language for 90-day notice + shim add-on (Elaine) — due Fri.
Sam (Eng): Bench harness will include synthetic and replay modes. Example run:
```
./bench --model=/models/customerX/v1 --seq=128 --qps=200 --warmup=300s
```
Outputs: p50/p95, tokens/sec, kv-cache-hit.
Omar (SRE): I'll map GPUs->QPS and include guidance for autoscale bursts (10% buffer) and multi-region egress notes.
Elaine (Product): Legal asks pin TTL and renewal process. Recommend default pin TTL = 180 days with auto-renew opt-in; include emergency rollback clause for security incidents.
Jia (PM): I'll consolidate into a one-pager for sales. Objections to 180d TTL or 99.9% SLA?
Sam (Eng): 99.9% OK for Dedicated if we carve out customer-side network. 180d is long; offer 90d for startups.
Elaine (Product): We'll add tiers: Enterprise default 180d, Startup/SMB 90d.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs/onboarding/sla-templates v2 -> prod at 2026-03-24T09:00Z :rocket:
Jia (PM): Thanks — will post the one-pager + checklist in #sales-wins when ready.
